stories.headline: Borrowers expecting mortgage rates to drop have hopes dashed
stories.description: Major lenders have raised rates on new deals in recent days, leaving many borrowers needing to make a decision.

stories.headline: Argentina to file criminal case against oil company operating in Falklands
stories.description: The move comes days after President Javier Milei stepped up Argentina's claims of sovereignty over the Falklands.

stories.headline: Saudi-Houthi fighting in Yemen escalates: What happened, and what’s next?
stories.description: Saudi Arabia promises firm retaliation after Houthi strikes injure 73 and disrupt energy facilities in southern cities.

stories.headline: Israeli forces kill Palestinian man and withhold his body near Nablus
stories.description: Israeli forces shot and killed a Palestinian man amid raids and arrests across the occupied West Bank.

stories.headline: As Sweden heads to polls, Israel and Palestine policies are on the ballot
stories.description: With the left-wing coalition ahead in polling, the current right-wing government’s policies could soon be up for debate.
